summary: Execution environment image pulls need outbound 80/443 to registry.redhat.io and cdn.quay.io plus cdn01 to cdn06.quay.io (cdn04 to cdn06 added April 1 2025); use hostnames, not IPs, and no quay.io login is needed.
questions: Which quay.io hosts must be allowed to pull Red Hat images?
Image pulls from registry.redhat.io fail behind a firewall
Do I need cdn04.quay.io in my allowlist?

answer_card.title: Firewall rules for Red Hat container image pulls
answer_card.answer_md:
Allow outbound TCP 80 and 443 (by hostname) to:
- `registry.redhat.io` (and `registry.access.redhat.com` if used)
- `cdn.quay.io`, `cdn01.quay.io`, `cdn02.quay.io`, `cdn03.quay.io`
- `cdn04.quay.io`, `cdn05.quay.io`, `cdn06.quay.io` (added April 1, 2025)

You keep pulling from registry.redhat.io; no quay.io login is needed.
